title_jp: {長野|ながの}に{早い|はやい}{雪|ゆき}
context: On 20 November 2026 the season's first strong cold wave reached {長野県|ながのけん} just before the three-day weekend: 20 cm of snow lay in {白馬|はくば} by 3 p.m., {長野市|ながのし} saw its first snow, and in {長和町|ながわまち} cars were stuck in a line of up to about 2 km that evening. {白馬八方尾根|はくばはっぽうおね} ski area moved its pre-opening about 10 days earlier, to 21 November. Source: NBS {長野放送|ながのほうそう}, TV{朝日|あさひ} (ANN).
scene: Sunday morning, snow outside. {恵子|けいこ}さん reads the snow news on her tablet, and you still have to clean the guesthouse after losing last night.

phrases.jp: {生まれて初めて|うまれてはじめて}{雪|ゆき}を{見ました|みました}。
phrases.en: I saw snow for the first time in my life.
phrases.note: {生|う}まれて{初|はじ}めて = for the first time ever. Stronger than {初|はじ}めて alone.

phrases.jp: {負けて|まけて}、めっちゃ{悔しい|くやしい|frustrating (after losing)|4}！
phrases.en: I lost and I'm so frustrated!
phrases.note: {悔|くや}しい is for losing or failing when you tried; {残念|ざんねん} is just 'too bad'.

phrases.jp: {着いた|ついた}ばかりなのに、もう{帰る|かえる}の？
phrases.en: You've only just arrived and you're leaving already?
phrases.note: 〜たばかりなのに = 'only just… and yet'. Said to a guest leaving early.

phrases.jp: {道|みち}が{凍って|こおって|to freeze|3}いるので、{滑らない|すべらない|to slip|4}ように{気をつけて|きをつけて}ください。
phrases.en: The road is frozen, so please be careful not to slip.
phrases.note: A warning you'll hear all winter at stations and on the news.

phrases.jp: {感動|かんどう|being deeply moved|4}して、{言葉|ことば}が{出なかった|でなかった}。
phrases.en: I was so moved I couldn't speak.
phrases.note: {感動|かんどう}する: moved by beauty, a film, kindness. Not 'excited' (ワクワクする).

dialogue_setting: The {田中|たなか} kitchen, Sunday 22 November, 8 a.m. Snow on the {縁側|えんがわ}; {恵子|けいこ}さん has the news open on her tablet.

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: アルちゃん、ニュース{見て|みて}。{白馬|はくば}はもう{雪|ゆき}が{20センチ|にじゅっセンチ}も{積もった|つもった|to pile up (snow)|3}って。
dialogue.en: アルちゃん, look at the news. In {白馬|はくば} 20 cm of snow has already piled up.

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: スキー{場|じょう|ski resort|3}も、いつもより{10日|とおか}{早く|はやく}オープンしたそうよ。
dialogue.en: And the ski resort opened ten days earlier than usual, they say.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: え、もう？{初雪|はつゆき|first snow of the season|3}、{昨日|きのう}の{夜|よる}{降った|ふった}ばかりなのに。{生まれて初めて|うまれてはじめて}の{雪|ゆき}だったんです。
dialogue.en: What, already? The first snow only fell last night. It was the first snow of my life.

dialogue.speaker: 田中さん
dialogue.note: ずら = だろう (Nagano dialect). いかん = いけない: you mustn't.
dialogue.jp: {長和町|ながわまち}じゃ、{車|くるま}が{2キロ|にキロ}も{動けなく|うごけなく}なったずら。{雪道|ゆきみち|snowy road|3}を{甘く見ちゃ|あまくみちゃ|to underestimate|3}いかん。
dialogue.en: In {長和町|ながわまち} cars got stuck for 2 km, right? Don't underestimate snowy roads.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: はい…。でも{今日|きょう}は{掃除|そうじ|cleaning|4}です。{対決|たいけつ|showdown|3}、{4対6|よんたいろく}で{負けちゃって|まけちゃって}…{悔しい|くやしい|frustrating (after losing)|4}！
dialogue.en: Yes… But today I'm cleaning. I lost the showdown 4 to 6… so frustrating!

dialogue.speaker: 田中さん
dialogue.note: だに = だよ (Nagano dialect, for emphasis). 〜てやる: doing a favour, from someone older.
dialogue.jp: {悔しい|くやしい|frustrating (after losing)|4}のは{本気|ほんき|serious, for real|4}だったからだに。{軽トラ|けいトラ|kei truck|3}で{送って|おくって|to give a lift|4}やる。
dialogue.en: You're frustrated because you were serious about it. I'll drive you in the kei truck.

listening.intro: On the way, {健太|けんた} sends you a voice message from the guesthouse. Type what he says.

lines.jp: {雪|ゆき}やから{気|き}ぃつけてな。{掃除|そうじ|cleaning|4}、{一緒|いっしょ}にやろか？
lines.en: It's snowing, so be careful. Shall we do the cleaning together?

grammar.form: verb た-form: + ばかり ({降|ふ}ったばかり, {来|き}たばかり) · before a noun: + ばかりの ({買|か}ったばかりの{靴|くつ}) · 'and yet': + ばかりなのに ({着|つ}いたばかりなのに)
grammar.explanation: Says something happened only a short time ago, as the speaker feels it: minutes or even months. 〜たところ means literally 'a moment ago'. Don't mix it up with て-form + ばかりいる, which means 'doing nothing but'.

examples.jp: {買った|かった}ばかりの{靴|くつ}が、もう{汚れた|よごれた|to get dirty|3}。
examples.en: The shoes I just bought are already dirty.

examples.jp: {日本|にほん}に{来た|きた}ばかりのころは、{何|なに}もわからなかった。
examples.en: When I had just come to Japan, I didn't understand anything.

quiz.question: {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}を{食べた|たべた}＿＿なのに、もうお{腹|なか}が{空いた|すいた|to get hungry|4}。
quiz.en: I only just ate lunch, and I'm already hungry.
quiz.explain: た-form + ばかりなのに: 'only just did it, and yet…'.

quiz_more.question: {先月|せんげつ}＿＿パソコンが{壊れた|こわれた|to break|4}。
quiz_more.en: The computer I bought just last month broke.
quiz_more.explain: Use the た-form, and ばかりの before a noun.

quiz_more.question: {弟|おとうと}はゲームをして＿＿いる。
quiz_more.en: My little brother does nothing but play games.
quiz_more.explain: て-form + ばかりいる = doing nothing but. た-form + ばかり would mean 'just did'.

kanji.where: On the orange electronic sign by the bridge, as {田中|たなか}さん's kei truck crawls down to the station.
kanji.breakdown: {路面凍結|ろめんとうけつ}: 路 road + 面 surface + 凍 freeze + 結 tie, set → 'the road surface has frozen'.
kanji.related: {注意|ちゅうい} = caution: {路面凍結|ろめんとうけつ}{注意|ちゅうい} is the full sign.

tip.title: Walk like a penguin
tip.body: Japanese news and stations really tell people to walk on ice like a penguin (ペンギン{歩き|あるき}): small steps, weight forward. In snowy towns, clearing snow ({雪かき|ゆきかき}) in front of your house is expected, and neighbours notice who does it.

challenge.hint: {動詞|どうし}た{形|けい} + ばかり
challenge.prompt: {健太|けんた} on LINE: 「{白馬|はくば}、もうオープンしたらしいで！{今度|こんど}{一緒|いっしょ}に{行こ|いこ}か？」 You reply: you only just saw snow, so it's still scary, but you want to go. One part is wrong.

parts.why: 'Just did' needs the た-form: {見|み}たばかり. {見|み}るばかり means 'only keep looking'.

challenge.model_answer: {雪|ゆき}を{見た|みた}ばかりだから、まだ{怖い|こわい|scary|4}けど、{行きたい|いきたい}！
challenge.explanation: {見|み}たばかりだから: the た-form + ばかり says you saw snow only very recently, and だから gives it as the reason. けど softens the fear before the real answer, {行|い}きたい. Plain form fits a friend on LINE.

vocab.note: {雪|ゆき}が{積|つ}もる. Not つもり (intention), though it sounds close.
{初|はつ} first + {雪|ゆき} snow. Also {初恋|はつこい}, first love.
Literally 'see as sweet'. {甘|あま}く{見|み}ないで = don't take it lightly.
{掃除|そうじ}する. Big end-of-year clean: {大掃除|おおそうじ}.
For losing or failing after trying. Sports players say it all the time.
{本気|ほんき}で = seriously. マジ is the slang version.

vocab.en: to give a lift; to send
vocab.note: {駅|えき}まで{送|おく}るよ = I'll drive you to the station.
{凍|こお}っている = is frozen. {冷凍|れいとう} = frozen food.
Also skiing: スキーで{滑|すべ}る. Exams: {試験|しけん}に{滑|すべ}る = fail (slang).
{感|かん} feel + {動|どう} move. {感動|かんどう}する, {感動的|かんどうてき}.

kanji_study.parts: 禾 grain radical + 責 (duty, demand) → grain piled up as the tax you owe: pile up, accumulate.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 績 (results): 積 has 禾 grain on the left, 績 has 糸 thread.

kanji_study.parts: 阝 hill radical on the left + 夅 two feet walking downward → coming down a hill: things fall from the sky, people get off.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 隆 (rise): 隆 has 生 at the bottom right.

extras.title: Snow words
extras.intro: What you'll hear in {鷹ノ原|たかのはら} from now until March.

items.note: {雪|ゆき}かきする: a daily job in snow country.

items.jp: {立ち往生|たちおうじょう|being stranded|2}
items.note: News word for cars or trains stuck in snow.
From 'studless'. Everyone here changes tyres in November.

extras.title: After losing
extras.intro: Three feelings that aren't the same.

items.note: You want to win next time.

items.jp: {残念|ざんねん|too bad, a pity|4}
items.note: Calmer, also for things you didn't try.
Something fell short of what you hoped.

items.jp: {次|つぎ}は{負けない|まけない}！
items.note: What you say after {悔|くや}しい.
